schemaNotes: market.v1 is extended additively (15/11/2026); every key of the earlier file is kept.

areas.<name>.state is NSW or QLD. areas.<name>.costRegion is a key of regionalCostFactors.factors. areas.<name>.fallbackTo names the area whose figures the area is anchored to when its own evidence is thin (a chain that ends in null, never a cycle). Areas with no match use the Regional NSW default or the Regional QLD default by state.

Every numeric range or value has low, high (or value), unit, asAt (DD/MM/YYYY), sources (at least one entry; a plain text entry means analyst judgement) and status (VERIFIED_LISTING, VERIFIED_REPORT or ESTIMATE).

areas.<name>.showroomRentPerM2PerYr, smallOfficeRentPerM2PerYr and smallRetailRentPerM2PerYr (with showroomComps, officeComps, retailComps) are optional extra rent fields, AUD per m2 per year ex GST. They are data only; the feasibility does not read them yet.

areas.<name>.netYieldPct is the yield the feasibility uses (see yieldMethod). areas.<name>.derivedNetYieldPct is the yield derived from asking sale prices and asking rents, kept for reference and not used. netYieldPct.tier names the yield tier.
saleComps, rentComps and landEvidence entries with carriedFrom were kept from the 13/11/2026 pass and not re-read.

regionalCostFactors: multiplier of the regional NSW build rate and site works rate. charges: council infrastructure charges (NSW_s7_12 percent of cost model, QLD per m2 GFA by use). softCosts: escalation, finance, selling and leasing allowances (data only).

yieldMethod.summary: Net yields are set from published evidence, not derived from asking prices. Regional small strata industrial yield was not published for any area, so each area is placed in a tier whose band is anchored to the evidence rows: metro last mile industrial 5.5 to 6.0 per cent (Y7) plus the Opteon regional spread of 30 to 150 basis points (Y6) gives about 5.8 to 7.5 per cent for a regional city; Queensland HTW analysed yields (Y1 to Y5) set Townsville, Mackay and South East Queensland; small towns carry the earlier 7.0 to 9.0 per cent band. The 13/11/2026 area bands were kept where they sit inside the evidence.
yieldMethod.whyNotDerived: The 15/11/2026 research derived net yields from asking sale price against asking rent (3 to 5 per cent in most areas, 1.8 to 3.3 per cent at Tweed Heads). Small strata units are asked at owner occupier prices and asking rents are often gross, so the ratio understates what an investor would accept. A sold Tamworth strata unit (Y9) is an example: about 4.8 per cent net on the suburb rent. The derived figures are kept in each area as derivedNetYieldPct. For small strata units the sell result is the better test of value; the hold result uses an investor yield and will read lower.

regionalCostFactors.method: Each factor is the midpoint of the lowest and the highest published multiplier (the sources conflict, so no single source is chosen). The base is the regional NSW strata workshop build rate, so regional NSW is 1.00. Published factors are relative to Sydney and no regional NSW factor was found (planning range 0.90 to 1.10, midpoint 1.00), so Sydney and regional NSW are treated as equal. The factor multiplies the build rate and the site works rate in the feasibility; it does not change the published ranges, so the low to high band is unchanged by it. All factors are editable in the panel.

regionalNSW.unit: multiplier of the regional NSW build rate and site works rate
regionalNSW.note: No published regional NSW factor in any source read. Planning range 0.90 to 1.10, midpoint 1.00. Feasly QS guide says regional areas cost 20 to 40 per cent less than capitals; the Feasly construction guide says regional can price above metro. These conflict, so the neutral midpoint is used.

seQLD.unit: multiplier of the regional NSW build rate and site works rate
seQLD.note: Brisbane. Midpoint of the lowest and highest of three conflicting sources: BMT 0.92 to 1.05, Feasly QS guide 0.95 to 1.15, and RLB Q4 2025 midpoint ratios 1.18 to 1.32 (metal clad 1.32, precast 1.18, office 1.22). (0.92 + 1.32) / 2 = 1.12. Used for Brisbane, Logan, Ipswich, Gold Coast and Sunshine Coast (no separate Gold Coast or Sunshine Coast factor was found).

northQLD.unit: multiplier of the regional NSW build rate and site works rate
